text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There. My preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Do you have any concerns?
choice_data_list: I was just thinking how you have so many rivals.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true. Every one of them<n>possesses
great speed and strength.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I will push past all of them. That's all<n>there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I don't... defeating the Beast will<n>forever be out of
reach.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's almost time. I must be on my<n>way.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I'm so nervous...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right, Spe? Try taking a<n>few deep
breaths.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'll try! Inhale... Inhaaale!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's right, Spe. Now let it out,<n>slowly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeesh, with all these big names<n>around, I doubt
there'll be much<n>chance for me to shine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I'm just gonna coast on<n>through. Don't
mind me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Really?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But alas... As much as I'd love to<n>grant that
request...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I can ignore someone<n>whose eyes are
screaming, "I'm<n>gonna win."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Oops. Shoulda worn my shades.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass! Today, let's have the ultimate<n>race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We gotta show our fans the race<n>they've been
dyin' to see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can already see my victory<n>celebration... Passion!
Applause! The<n>crowd goes wiiiiild!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Are you sure that's how it will turn<n>out? Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is here at last!
